name: cold-blue-editorial-macro
keep: KEEP — the making of the image, copy exactly:
· MEDIUM: extreme macro editorial fashion photograph, tight crop filling the frame with a single face, razor-sharp pore-level detail.
· LIGHT: dramatic cinematic lighting — cold blue-violet key from above meeting a warm amber bounce below, glossy wet-look sheen on skin and lips.
· GROUND: dark, out-of-focus indoor backdrop with faint horizontal slats and a hint of white fur at the edge.
· MAKEUP + HARDWARE: powder-blue smeared eyeshadow, clustered crystal-stud piercings, tiny star-shaped tooth gems.
· SIGNATURE TREATMENT: flat hand-added graphics laid over the photo — a solid magenta-pink five-point star and a few crisp cobalt-blue drawn lines.
· PALETTE: deep espresso-brown skin, icy steel-blue, hot magenta-pink accent, warm amber undertone.
· MOOD: confrontational, glamorous and raw; smooth high-resolution surface with almost no grain.
· No readable text, no letters, no numerals, no logo, no watermark anywhere.
